purpose: Does the provision that governs a Legal MC question, placed before the frozen MC prompt, fix the questions Qwen3.5-9B answers wrongly, and does it break the ones it answers correctly?

selection.pool: the Legal MC items of the wide phase, each answered by arm B on two draws: B-r1 of MC-90 and B-r2 of MC-91
selection.wrong: every pool item that B answered wrongly on at least one of the two draws

right.from: the pool items that B answered correctly on both draws
right.order: ascending SHA-256 of the UTF-8 string legal-oracle-v1|<item_id>

arms.B: the item's frozen main-v1 MC prompt, byte for byte
arms.O: the campaign evidence block with the item's oracle provisions, then the same frozen prompt (build_arm_prompt with arm O)

o_requires: at least one provision, whatever its support label

evidence.located_by: four Claude agents, 14 items each in item-id order, blind to the stratum, from the exact prompt and the gold letter; locations only
evidence.unit: a whole article, or its heading line and the named clauses when the article exceeds 6,000 characters; at most two provisions per item
evidence.text: extracted by code, verbatim, from the stored page
evidence.reader: articles as corpus v0 reads them (top-level article elements), except that a page breaking off inside its last article element keeps the articles closed before it, and an attached document without article elements (a Quy chế issued by a Quyết định) is read from the page text after its heading line, named in the location's `part`; named clauses must exist in the article

review.order: ascending SHA-256 of the UTF-8 string legal-oracle-review|<item_id>, among items with a provision
review.verdict: the owner's label replaces the agent's on reviewed items
review.answers: the owner also records, per reviewed item, the option the provision makes correct; the review file stays outside the repository and its SHA-256 is registered

analysis.item_score: mean correctness of an arm over its two draws
analysis.primary_set: items whose final support label is supports_gold
analysis.comparison: O against fresh B, per stratum
analysis.gold_check: descriptive: on the reviewed items, the owner's option against the gold; on contradicts_gold items, each arm's answers that pick the gold's option, the owner's option or another
